mapper.sql: answer_id, binding_id, student_id, lesson_id, source_sheet_id, answer_json, current_page, status, auto_score, manual_adjustment, total_score, grading_status, grading_detail, draft_revision, submit_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.answer_id, a.binding_id, a.student_id, a.lesson_id, a.source_sheet_id, a.answer_json, a.current_page, a.status, a.auto_score, a.manual_adjustment, a.total_score, a.grading_status, a.grading_detail, a.draft_revision, a.submit_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM biz_guide_sheet_answer a INNER JOIN biz_guide_sheet_progress p ON p.binding_id = a.binding_id AND p.student_id = a.student_id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND p.dept_id = #{deptId} AND p.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND p.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY a.submit_time DESC, a.answer_id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_guide_sheet_answer
answer_json = #{answerJson}, current_page = #{currentPage}, status = #{status},
auto_score = NULL, manual_adjustment = 0, total_score = NULL, grading_status = NULL, grading_detail = NULL,
auto_score = #{autoScore},
manual_adjustment = #{manualAdjustment},
total_score = #{totalScore},
grading_status = #{gradingStatus},
grading_detail = #{gradingDetail},
submit_time = #{submitTime}, draft_revision = #{draftRevision}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
AND status != '2'
AND draft_revision < #{draftRevision}
AND draft_revision < #{draftRevision}

UPDATE biz_guide_sheet_answer SET auto_score = #{autoScore}, manual_adjustment = COALESCE(#{manualAdjustment}, 0), total_score = #{totalScore}, grading_status = #{gradingStatus}, grading_detail = #{gradingDetail}, update_time = NOW() WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} AND status = '2' AND draft_revision = #{draftRevision}
